title: Orange Warrior Poses
description: Four side-by-side photographic panels show a young Black girl in an elaborate, tattered orange and black post-apocalyptic costume. She stands in slightly varied dynamic poses with hands raised, wearing skull-adorned armor, patterned leggings, and heavy boots against a dark textured studio backdrop.
